clue.text: On the way out, see bone in the middle of earthwork

indicators.note: the bone sits in the centre of the earthwork, so one word is set inside the other

parts.note: a mound is a bank of earth, an earthwork
a rib is a bone of the chest

explanation.surface: An instruction to look at a bone buried in an earthwork that is falling into ruin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' is a link word. RIB goes inside MOUND, splitting it as MO and UND.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dying or in terminal decline is said to be on its way out.

clue.text: Omit a line from the book

parts.note: to miss something out is to omit it

explanation.surface: Someone is told to cut a line from a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A missal is the service book of the Mass, the book used at the altar.

clue.text: Discuss beheading for treachery

indicators.note: taking the head off a word removes its first letter, here the opening T

parts.note: treason is betrayal of one's country, treachery

explanation.surface: A suggestion to debate whether beheading is the punishment for treachery.
explanation.definitionFit: To reason with someone is to argue or talk a matter through, to discuss it.

clue.text: Cunning between the sheets provided charming diversion

indicators.note: the cunning goes between the sheets, so it is set inside the word for bed

parts.note: being between the sheets means being in bed
guile is craft or cunning

explanation.surface: A seduction in bed offers a pleasant distraction.
explanation.walkthrough: GUILE goes inside BED, splitting it as BE and D.
explanation.definitionFit: To beguile someone is to amuse or entertain them, passing the time pleasantly.

clue.text: Emperor in fine robes

indicators.note: the emperor is found inside the run of letters of the phrase fine robes

explanation.surface: A Roman emperor dressed in splendid robes.
explanation.walkthrough: The name runs across the words: fiNE RObes.
explanation.definitionFit: Nero was the Roman emperor notorious for the fire of Rome.

clue.text: Losing his nerve, a father needs assistance

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title
aid means help or assistance

explanation.surface: A dad who has lost his nerve needs help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone frightened, with their courage gone, has lost their nerve.

clue.text: Show off fellow student to a relative

parts.note: L, the learner plate, stands for a student
an aunt is a relative

explanation.surface: A college fellow and a student showing off to a family member.
explanation.walkthrough: L stands for learner, from the L-plates on British learner drivers' cars; 'to' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To flaunt something is to display it ostentatiously, to show it off.

clue.text: Funny anagram for cold drink

indicators.note: something funny is odd or peculiar, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: A remark that a comical anagram is a stand-in for a chilled beverage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Funny' rearranges ANAGRAM into ARMAGNA; 'for' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Armagnac is a brandy from Gascony, an after-dinner spirit.

clue.text: Present people joining the party

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: Citizens joining a political party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joining' is a link word placing the pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A donation is a gift, something given or presented.

clue.text: Haul guns back to get this game

indicators.note: the whole phrase built from haul and guns is read from right to left

parts.note: to drag is to haul
gats are guns in gangster slang

explanation.surface: Instructions to drag weapons back to bag some quarry.
explanation.walkthrough: DRAG then GATS gives DRAGGATS, and 'back' turns the whole run around.
explanation.definitionFit: A staggard is a stag in its fourth year, a deer hunted as game.

clue.text: Local employee

parts.note: the local is a pub, so this is someone who works behind its bar, not a local resident in a job

explanation.walkthrough: 'Local' reads as an adjective, but in Britain your local is your nearby pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A pub, called the local in Britain, employs a bartender to serve drinks.

clue.text: Small tender tree can get raised inside

indicators.note: the raised can is set within the tree's name

parts.note: the pine is a tree

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the word is read upwards, from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Young saplings that can be grown indoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get raised' turns CAN to NAC, which goes inside PINE. A tender is a small boat serving a larger ship, not a gentle quality.
explanation.definitionFit: A pinnace is a ship's small boat used to ferry people and supplies.

clue.text: Debilitated by a stimulant?

parts.note: a tonic is a stimulating, invigorating medicine

explanation.surface: Someone weakened, ironically, by a pick-me-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Atonic describes muscles lacking normal tone, slack and weakened.

clue.text: Dim thing floating around at this time?

indicators.note: drifting about loosely, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something faint drifts about in the dark hours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve o'clock at night is the dim hour when things float about in the dark.

clue.text: The two, in other words begin search for housing in Scotland

parts.note: both means the two together
i.e. (id est) means that is, in other words

indicators.note: only the beginning of the word search is used, its opening letter

explanation.surface: Two people start searching for a home north of the border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Bothies are simple huts or cottages in Scotland, used as shelters.

clue.text: Tell the old story about Dracula

parts.note: re means about or concerning
Dracula is a count in Bram Stoker's novel

explanation.surface: Someone retells the classic vampire story.
explanation.definitionFit: To recount a story is to narrate it again in detail.

clue.text: Fancy skirting, presented trouble behind back of cupboard

indicators.note: the trouble comes after the other piece
the back of a word is its last letter

parts.note: ado is fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: Decorative skirting board is fitted, with difficulty, behind a cupboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'presented' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A dado is a decorative panel or rail along the lower part of a wall.

clue.text: Transport takes care, circling a rig that's damaged

indicators.note: care goes around the other letters, holding them inside

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: a damaged thing is broken, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A transporter handles a damaged rig carefully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's damaged' rearranges A RIG into RIAG, which goes inside CARE between CAR and E; 'takes' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A carriage is a wheeled vehicle, a means of transport.

clue.text: American literary critic sensational? Off with his head!

indicators.note: something taken off is removed from the word

parts.note: thrilling means exciting or sensational

indicators.note: the head of the word his is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone shouts for a sensational critic to be beheaded.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests beheading the word, but the H removed is the head of 'his'. Lionel Trilling was an American critic.
explanation.definitionFit: Lionel Trilling wrote 'The Liberal Imagination', a major work of American literary criticism.

clue.text: Maverick Eastern grandee reformed

indicators.note: formed anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An Oriental nobleman who has turned over a new leaf.
explanation.definitionFit: A renegade is a rebel who breaks from the group, a maverick.

clue.text: A church leader about to give ground

indicators.note: the leader of the word church is its first letter

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A clergyman is about to give up some land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to give' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: An acre is a measure of land, a piece of ground.

clue.text: Where the tick may be concealed

definitions.text: Where the tick may be concealed

parts.words: Where the tick may be concealed
parts.note: a parasite lurking in dense undergrowth, its hiding place

explanation.walkthrough: The letters of 'the tick' rearrange into the answer, a bonus for the solver.
explanation.definitionFit: Ticks hide in a thicket, dense shrubbery where animals brush past.

clue.text: Profit you don't keep?

definitions.meaning: something handed back, such as goods taken back to a shop or a tax form sent in

explanation.definitionFit: A yield on money is its return, and anything given back to its owner is also a return.

clue.text: Work with the Queen at the helm

parts.note: to till is to work the soil
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A labourer with royalty steering the ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' and 'at' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiller is the bar used to steer a boat, the helm itself.

clue.text: Saul, my doctor providing relief

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man named Saul addresses his physician, who brings relief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' looks like a noun, but it is a verb here; 'providing' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Asylum is sanctuary or refuge, a respite from persecution.

clue.text: Happy to have ended your shift on guard?

definitions.meaning: glad that a worry has passed

definitions.text: to have ended your shift on guard?
definitions.meaning: a sentry is replaced by the next guard at the end of a watch

explanation.definitionFit: Feeling relief is gladness, and a sentry whose watch is taken over by another has been stood down.

clue.text: Negligent about a girl

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a miss is a girl

explanation.surface: Someone careless when it comes to a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Remiss means careless in one's duty, negligent.

clue.text: A number sea-sick in this vessel

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five

indicators.note: unwell, so the letters of sea are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone seasick, using a pot as a sick bowl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sick' rearranges SEA into ASE; 'A' and 'in' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A vase is a container, a vessel for flowers.

clue.text: Hostility is total in a recession

indicators.note: going back, so the whole phrase is read from right to left

parts.note: a sum is a total

explanation.surface: Economic gloom breeding resentment.
explanation.walkthrough: SUM, IN and A make SUMINA, and 'recession' turns the whole run around; 'is' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Animus is ill will or animosity, hostility toward someone.

clue.text: In these bars, first-rate plea and all turn out

indicators.note: turned out of their order, the letters are rearranged
only the first letter of rate is used

explanation.surface: In a court, a first-rate plea and everybody appearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' gives R from 'rate', and 'turn out' rearranges R with PLEA and ALL; 'In' and 'and' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Parallel bars are the pair of gymnastic rails used in men's gymnastics.

clue.text: Moving cautiously to the border

definitions.meaning: inching forward a little at a time
a trim along the edge of something

explanation.definitionFit: Creeping sideways or forward by degrees, and a decorative trim around a hem, share the word.

clue.text: Cold beer mixed with spirit —— it gives one thought

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

indicators.note: mixed up, so the letters of beer are rearranged

parts.note: rum is a spirit

explanation.surface: A cocktail of cold beer and rum, which gets one thinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixed' rearranges BEER into EREB; 'with' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The cerebrum is the main part of the brain, the seat of conscious thinking.
